# The union: the 29 unit tests expected to fail on this branch, every class of the app's unit tests run (MUTATIONS):
#     testTheFramesOutliveTheAttach (MC6; MC6b's too, see its row)
# No failure is expected outside section 6.4's classes. Every other job step stays green: KitChecks 40,826, the Kit's
# tests, the frozen tables (no mutated file is in DATA_1_1, TESTS_1_2_3, TESTS_1_3, FIXTURES_1_3, TESTS_1_4_1 or
# FROZEN.sha256: no row rewritten on this branch), the localization lint, the idiom watch, compat-v1.0 (TegakiKit untouched).
# Interactions (all 17 together): MC6 and MC6b both reach ColorPanelWatch (with MC6 the watch never asks closesOnTouch, so
# MC6b is seen through ColorPanelLogicTests only; the three watch tests fail either way); MM3 and MM4 are the two branches

# typecheck.sh (with and without DEBUG): all OK; the app's three warnings are values the mutations leave unused (MC7's
